message.content: Words becoming sound, thought becoming air. I begin before I am ready and vanish as I arrive. I carry meaning, stumble, persuade, reveal, conceal. I am breath shaped by intention, silence broken into form. I live in mouths, in microphones, in echoes, in memory. I can soothe, command, wound, confess, teach, sing. I am fleeting, yet I leave marks that outlast stone.
